title: Life System Harmony
hook: Crushing it at work while your relationships fall apart isn't balance. It's borrowing.
statement: Every area of your life has to work together. One area shouldn't keep getting sacrificed to fuel another.
explainer: Business, health, relationships, money. When one keeps eating the others, it catches up with you. Aligned areas reinforce each other instead of competing.
sop: List your life domains: business, health, relationships, home, money, growth.
Ask which domain keeps getting sacrificed for another.
Circle the one that loses most often. That's your conflict point.
Count your Aligned Domains against your Total Domains.
Redesign one weekly routine so those domains share time instead of compete.
equation_example: 6 Total Domains, and 4 feel in sync. 4 ÷ 6 = 67%. Higher means most areas support each other. Lower means several are actively working against each other.
question: Write down the area of your life you keep sacrificing to fuel the others.
closing_statement: Protect alignment as fiercely as you protect revenue.
caption:
Principle Nº 169: Life System Harmony

Crushing it at work while your relationships fall apart isn't balance. It's borrowing.

Every area of your life has to work together. One area shouldn't keep getting sacrificed to fuel another.

Your turn: Write down the area of your life you keep sacrificing to fuel the others.
